title: RefmusePaper
description:
About RefmusePaper

RefmusePaper connects AI-assisted creation with local wallpaper management. Use the online Refmuse Workbench to create static wallpapers and live/video wallpapers from text prompts or reference images, import selected results into your local library, and apply them to your desktop.

Key features

- Generate static wallpaper images through the online Refmuse Workbench

- Generate live/video wallpapers with supported cloud models

- Create with text prompts, reference images, and multiple image references

- Import selected results into your local RefmusePaper library

- Organize, rename, and download original wallpaper files

- Apply static and live wallpapers to the Windows desktop

- Sync supported wallpaper library data with Steam Cloud

- Use the interface in English or Simplified Chinese

- Browse the Wallpaper Community and submit eligible Workbench-generated images for moderation

AI creation and credits

AI-assisted creation requires an internet connection, a Refmuse account, and available credits. Additional credits purchased in the Steam version are processed through Steam Wallet. The required credit amount is shown before a generation task is submitted. Available models, generation modes, duration, resolution, and processing time may vary with service availability. Prompts, reference images, and generated results are subject to automated safety checks, provider review, and content restrictions.

Live wallpaper notes

Live wallpaper generation uses supported cloud video models. Available first-frame, first-and-last-frame, reference-image, duration, and resolution options depend on the selected model. The Windows version can play supported video results as live wallpapers. Feature availability may vary by operating system.

Mainland China availability

RefmusePaper is currently unavailable for purchase on Steam in mainland China due to a Steam regional restriction. A region-specific version for mainland China is currently in development. Its feature scope and release schedule have not yet been finalized. Product availability and online services may vary by region.
description_short: RefmusePaper combines an AI creation workbench with desktop wallpaper management. Generate static images and live wallpapers from prompts or references, import and organize results, and apply them on Windows. AI generation requires internet access, a Refmuse account, and credits.
